headline: Premier League recap: Chelsea beat Fulham in five-goal thriller
description: Chelsea scored in the opening minute and didn't look back in a fun, end-to-end 3-2 win at Fulham to open their 2026-27 Premier League campaign.

headline: Manchester City agree €40M deal for Allan Elias - sources
description: Manchester City have agreed a deal with Palmeiras for winger Allan Elias, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Al Hilal eye move for Arsenal's Martinelli

headline: Enzo Fernández named on Chelsea bench for Fulham clash
description: Enzo Fernández has been named on the bench for Chelsea's Premier League opener against Fulham amid uncertainty around his future at the club.

headline: Éderson on failed Man United move: 'I honestly don't know what happened'
